title: Shrinkwrap OpenSSL + JWT runtimes and remediate SSO edge-cases
creator: Maya Patel
description: Reduce our attack surface and stabilize production inference runtimes by shrinkwrapping OpenSSL transitive ABI, consolidating JWT/OAuth libraries into a single vetted facade, and adding targeted SAML/SSO parser hardening. This ticket covers build-time pinning, runtime compatibility profiles, canary rollout, and follow-up remediation tasks discovered during smoke runs.
comments: 2025-02-12 - Maya P: Kickoff meeting notes: target is to eliminate differing OpenSSL symbols across runtime images (hosted/dedicated/private) and centralize JWT parsing. Blockers: downstream vendor library using old OpenSSL APIs; need supplier coordination.

2025-02-18 - Omar R: PoC complete for shrinkwrap: created shim libcrypto-compat that exposes a reduced symbol table and forwards to system OpenSSL. Measured +1.2ms median cold-start on a g5 instance — acceptable. PoC branch: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2317

2025-02-22 - Security review: flagged potential JWS header parsing ambiguity in legacy jwt-legacy-adapter. Decided to add strict header validation and reject unknown alg values. Created follow-up: ENG-129874 (strict-jws-headers)

2025-02-26 - QA: Canary on "crypto-compat" runtime-profile in us-west-2 with 2% traffic. Observed two unusual token parsings from an old SSO provider; added transformation shim that normalizes missing typ header. Documented provider fingerprint in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/SSO-Provider-Fingerprints

2025-03-01 - Omar R: Rolling upgrade plan drafted. Steps: 1) publish shrinkwrapped images to internal registry; 2) enable runtime-profile=crypto-compat in staging; 3) 24h smoke; 4) 2% live canary; 5) incrementally bump to 25%/75%/100% with automated rollback on token-failure-rate > 0.5%

2025-03-03 - Maya P: Decision log: we will not force FIPS in the initial rollout to avoid kernel-ABI differences; instead ship an opt-in FIPS build in a follow-up. Security review required before prod flip (flagged).
